name: b5subtheme

scripts.check:critical: test -s css/critical.css && grep -q 'site-header' css/critical.css && grep -q 'utility-bar' css/critical.css
scripts.build: npm run prod && npm run check:critical

_overrides_note: Every entry below forces a transitive build-time dep of laravel-mix 6 up to
a patched release. None of this ships to browsers (that is bootstrap and
fontawesome under 'dependencies'); the compiled CSS is committed.
Rules: pin the LOWEST version that exits the advisory range, and never
cross a major. Two things bit us on 2026-07-29 and must not be repeated:
1. Do NOT force brace-expansion to the 5.x 'fix'. 5.x exports {expand}
instead of a callable default, so minimatch@3 throws 'expand is not a
function' on any brace pattern. The advisory (<=5.0.7) has no
compatible fix for the 1.x/2.x lines; natural resolution is correct.
2. Do NOT override minimatch. A global pin collides with the purgecss
subtree and yields an invalid tree where glob@7 gets minimatch@9
(an object, not a function). Natural resolution gives 3.1.5 / 9.0.9.
When a lock entry already satisfies an override, npm will not re-resolve
it: delete that entry from package-lock.json and reinstall. Never delete
the whole lockfile -- that floats bootstrap/sass and changes rendered CSS.
Verify any change with: npm run prod && diff against the committed CSS.
